title: Best Free AI Agent Builders 2026: 12 Free Plans Checked
summary: Free AI agent builders compared on Nov 7, 2026: run caps, credits and first paid prices for 12 tools, plus the trials sold as free. No-code and open source.
body_markdown:
Every AI agent builder has a "free" button. Half of them lead to a trial.


> **TL;DR:** We checked 12 free AI agent builders on each vendor's pricing page on November 7, 2026. **Taskade Genesis** is the only free plan we checked that runs your agent inside a live app anyone can open, with a database and[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) : 1 agent, 3 apps, 10 automation runs, no card. Free starts with 0 AI credits. Pro is $10/mo billed yearly.[Create your first free agent](https://www.taskade.com/learn/agents/custom-agents) .


The best free AI agent builder in 2026 is Taskade Genesis if you want the agent to do real work for real people. It is the only free plan we checked that runs the agent inside a published app, with a database that keeps every answer and an automation that acts on it.[Zapier Agents](https://zapier.com/agents) is the best free pick for teams that already run Zaps, with 400 agent activities a month.[Botpress](https://botpress.com/) is the best free chat agent for a website, with 3 agents and 100 conversations a month. If you have a server,[n8n](https://n8n.io/) and[Dify](https://dify.ai/) are free to self-host. We read every vendor's own pricing page on November 7, 2026, and six tools that other lists still call free turned out to be trials or sales-only.


*Cover photo: a Bell System switchboard for overseas calls, 1940s. U.S. National Archives via Wikimedia Commons, no known copyright restrictions.*


For most of the 20th century, the "agent" between a caller and the answer was a person at a switchboard. She listened, asked one question, and plugged the call into the right line. A free AI agent does the same job today: it listens, asks, looks something up, and routes the result somewhere useful. The hard part was never the listening. It was the plugging in, and that is still where free plans differ most.


*Last updated: November 8, 2026. Facts checked on 2026-11-07.*

## What Is the Best Free AI Agent Builder in 2026?


Taskade Genesis is the best free AI agent builder in 2026, because it is the only free plan we checked that runs the agent inside a published app with a project database and automations on one link. Its weakest point is plain: Free starts with 0 AI credits, so the agent answers once you earn credits or upgrade.


That trade-off is the whole story of free agent builders in late 2026. Some free plans give you generous AI usage and nowhere to put the result. Others give you a place to put the result and a small meter for the AI. Taskade sits in the second group. Zapier Agents and MindStudio sit closer to the first.


### What a Free Agent Builder Must Do


A free AI agent builder earns the name when it passes four checks. The checks come from what people actually build with a free agent: a lead form, a support bot, a study helper, an inbox sorter.


1. **No end date.** The $0 plan resets each month. It is not a 7-day or 14-day trial.
2. **It can act.** The agent can use a tool or an app: search, save a row, send an email.
3. **It knows you.** You can give it your own files, links or records as knowledge.
4. **People reach it.** A visitor or a teammate can talk to it on a link, a widget or a channel.


Ten of the 12 builders in this guide pass check 1 on a hosted plan. n8n passes it only when you self-host, and Langflow does not publish its cloud limits. Checks 2 to 4 split the field further, and thechecklist table shows each tool's result.


### Who Publishes This List, and What We Make From It


Taskade publishes this guide, and Taskade Genesis is ranked first in it. That is a conflict of interest, so here is the basis for the placement instead of an assertion: on the vendor pages we read on November 7, 2026, Taskade was the only free plan that puts the agent, a public link, a database and automations in one published app. Every competitor number in this guide links to that vendor's own pricing page, so you can check it without taking our word for it.


Where a competitor's free plan is better, the entry says so. Zapier has the largest app catalog in this list, and its agents reuse the connections you already set up. Botpress gives 3 agents and 3 seats on its free plan, more than most hosted free plans. MindStudio gives 1,000 runs a month on its hosted free plan. n8n and Dify have no usage cap from the vendor when you self-host. Retool puts agents, apps and workflows on one free plan for internal teams.


## Is a Free AI Agent Builder Actually Free?


A free AI agent builder is free in one of four ways: a recurring free plan, a time-boxed trial, a one-time credit grant, or open-source software you host yourself. Only a recurring free plan or a self-hosted copy keeps an agent running at $0 next month, and both still meter something.

A cap that ends mid-build is worse than a cap that ends after launch. A builder that runs out before your agent answers its first real visitor has shown you a demo, not a free plan.


### Who Pays for the AI Model?


The AI model is the hidden line item in every free agent builder. MindStudio bills model usage per token at the provider's price, with no markup, on its Free plan. Activepieces charges 2, 10 or 20 extra credits for each AI step, by model class. Botpress covers $0.10 of AI usage in each conversation on its paid Plus and Team plans, and its pricing page did not state an AI allowance for Free. Self-hosted n8n, Dify, Langflow and CrewAI need your own model key, so you pay the model provider directly.


Taskade Free starts with 0 AI credits. Your agent's replies, and the replies it writes to public visitors, use AI credits from the workspace. Pro includes 50,000 AI credits a month, and the[AI agent cost guide](https://www.taskade.com/blog/ai-agent-cost-optimization) shows how to stretch them.


### Can a Free Agent Talk to the Public?


A free agent is only useful when someone can reach it. Taskade publishes an agent as a[public link or a website widget](https://www.taskade.com/learn/agents/public-agents) on every plan, Free included, and visitor chats land in the Visitor Inbox. Each visitor reply uses AI credits from your workspace, and a password on the public page needs a paid plan.


Botpress Free covers 100 conversations a month across 3 agents. Zapier Free includes 2 chatbots, which are a separate product from Zapier Agents. Retool Free serves up to 5 internal users, so it fits a team helper, not a public bot. MindStudio's pricing page did not state a publishing limit for Free on November 7, 2026.

### A Worked Example: 30 Leads a Week


Here is the same small job on four meters. A website agent talks to 30 leads a week, about 130 a month. For each lead it asks three questions, saves a row and emails the owner when the lead is hot.


- **Botpress Free:** 130 conversations is more than the 100 included, and Free has no top-ups, so the agent stops answering in the fourth week.
- **Zapier Agents Free:** each lead is one agent run. If one lead takes 3 activities (read the form, save the row, send the email), 130 leads use about 390 of the 400 activities. One extra lookup per lead ends the month early.
- **Activepieces Free:** each flow run is 1 credit, and each AI step on a fast model adds 2. A one-AI-step flow costs about 3 credits a lead, or about 390 a month, inside the 1,000-credit allowance.
- **Taskade Free:** the agent chat happens inside the app, and each email is one automation run. 130 runs would pass the 10 runs in a billing period, so on Free the email automation covers about the first 10 leads, and Pro's 1,000 runs cover the month. Every agent reply uses AI credits, which Free earns rather than starts with.


The per-activity and per-step costs above are our arithmetic on each vendor's published unit. Vendors do not publish a cost per lead, and a real agent can take more steps than this example.


### The First Paid Price


The first paid step ranges from $10 a month to $150 a month across the hosted builders that publish a price in US dollars. The chart leaves out n8n (priced in euros), Make (price not shown to our checker), and Stack AI and CrewAI (Enterprise only).


*Retool is $10 per builder, plus $5 per internal user. Dify Professional is $590 a year per workspace, shown as $49 a month. Zapier Agents Pro is "about $33.33" a month billed annually. Facts checked on 2026-11-07.*


## An Agent Alone vs an Agent Inside a Live App


Most free AI agent builders give you a chat box or a workflow node. Taskade Genesis puts the agent inside an app with a database and automations on one shareable link, so the answer the agent collects is saved, shown and acted on in the same place. That difference decides whether a free agent saves you work or adds a copy-and-paste step.


Here is a live example. Lead Capture Chatbot is a Taskade Genesis app where visitors ask an agent about services, prices and openings, and the leads land in a project. Click around below.


The kit ships with 5 projects, 1 AI agent and 3 automations, according to[its kit page](https://www.taskade.com/apps/all/lead-capture-chatbot-0l52edd1kfvk6zg9) on November 7, 2026. Because it holds automations,[cloning the full kit](https://www.taskade.com/app/lead-capture-chatbot-0l52edd1kfvk6zg9?action=clone&utm_source=landing_blog&utm_content=free-ai-agent-builders) needs a paid plan. On Free, create one custom agent yourself and build the email automation yourself.


Taskade Genesis Tutorial: Build an AI App With Agents and Automations, No Code


**Citation capsule:** Taskade calls this loop Workspace DNA. Projects are the Memory, AI agents are the Intelligence, and automations are the Execution. An agent in a Taskade Genesis app reads the same projects your team edits, writes back to them, and triggers automations across 100+ integrations, so the agent, the data and the action share one workspace and one plan.


The agent-alone model still wins for some jobs. A Zapier agent that works through your existing Zaps needs no app, and a Botpress bot on a website needs no database to answer a FAQ. Pick the agent-in-an-app model when the agent collects something you need to keep, such as a lead, a ticket or a booking.


## How We Checked 12 Free AI Agent Builders


We read the pricing page of every builder in this guide on November 7, 2026, and recorded the free-plan meter, the free-plan caps, the card rule and the first paid price in the vendor's own words. Where a pricing page was silent, we read the vendor's documentation or GitHub repository and named that source.


The brief we use to judge fit is fixed: *"Build a lead qualification agent for a small agency website. It asks 3 questions, scores the lead from 1 to 10, saves the lead to a table, and emails the owner when the score is 8 or higher. Share it with a public link."* For each tool, we asked one question of its plan page: can a $0 plan do each part of that brief, and which meter ends it?


Three honesty notes on method:


- **Checked, not tested.** This edition reads plan pages and docs. We did not open 12 fresh accounts and run the brief end to end, so no score below claims a hands-on result.
- **Not stated means not stated.** If a vendor's page did not state a limit, such as MindStudio's publishing rule on Free or Langflow's cloud limits, the table says so. We do not fill gaps with third-party numbers.
- **One blocked page.** Make's pricing page did not show plan prices to our checker. Make's free credits and its AI Agents availability come from Make's own pages. Its Core price is marked as unverified.

## 1.[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/ai/agents) : Best Free Agent Builder for an Agent Inside a Live App


Taskade Genesis builds AI agents inside the same workspace as your projects and automations. You describe the agent, attach knowledge, and publish it as a public link or a website widget. Taskade EVE can build a whole app around the agent from one prompt.


**Key features:** knowledge from projects, files and links; built-in tools such as web search, code and file analysis; a public link, a website widget and a Visitor Inbox on every plan; automations with 100+ integrations; apps where the agent, the database and the automations share one link.


**Free plan (checked Nov 7, 2026):** 1 agent with 1 knowledge item, 3 apps, 2 members and 10 automation runs per billing period. Free automations use built-in steps such as **Send an email** ([automation actions](https://www.taskade.com/learn/automation/actions) ) and standard connectors such as HTTP Request. Premium connectors such as Gmail and Slack need a paid plan. Free starts with 0 AI credits. On Free, you earn free AI credits with referrals and invites, and you can upgrade any time.


**Pros**


- The only free plan we checked with an agent, a database and automations in one published app.
- A public link and a website widget on every plan.
- No credit card, and no end date.


**Cons**


- Free starts with 0 AI credits, so the agent replies only after you earn credits or upgrade.
- 1 agent with 1 knowledge item on Free, and agent export starts on Pro.
- Premium connectors and kits that hold automations need a paid plan, and webhooks need Pro.


**Pricing:** Pro is $10 a month billed annually ($20 monthly): unlimited agents and apps, 50 knowledge items, 50,000 AI credits a month, 1,000 runs and 10 members. Business is $25 a month billed annually. Claude runs in custom agents on Pro and up with[your own API key](https://www.taskade.com/blog/byok-ai-builders) .


**Bottom line:** the free plan to pick when the agent must collect something you keep, such as a lead, a ticket or a booking, and act on it.

## 2.[Zapier Agents](https://zapier.com/agents) : Best Free Agent for Teams That Already Run Zaps


Zapier Agents lets you describe an agent in plain words and give it access to the apps you already connected in Zapier. The agent works through a task step by step: it searches, reads and acts in those apps. For a team with years of Zaps, it is the shortest path from automation to an agent.


**Key features:** plain-language agent setup; access to Zapier's app directory through your existing connections; agents that run on a trigger, on a schedule or on demand; handoff to a Zap for fixed steps; Zapier Chatbots and Tables as separate products on the same account.


**Free plan (checked Nov 7, 2026):** 400 agent activities a month, with up to 10 activities in one agent run. Activities do not use your Zap task allowance. The same Free account includes 100 tasks a month for Zaps, 2 chatbots and Tables with 2,500 records. Zapier's pricing page did not state a card rule for Free, and it lists a 14-day Professional trial with no card.


**Pros**


- The largest app catalog in this guide, and agents reuse connections you already made.
- Agent activities sit outside the task pool, so a free agent does not eat your Zaps' tasks.
- The plain-language setup suits operations staff who already think in triggers and actions.


**Cons**


- The 10-activity cap per run stops a long research task early and asks you to continue.
- Agents are separate from Zapier Chatbots, so a public chat page is a second product with its own limit.
- Costs stack when you pay for both Zaps and Agents.


**Pricing:** Agents Pro starts at about $33.33 a month billed annually, with 1,500 activities a month and up to 40 per run. Zapier Professional for Zaps is $19.99 a month billed annually, or $29.99 monthly, for 750 tasks. The two are priced separately.


**Bottom line:** the best free agent when your company already lives in Zapier and the agent's job is to work across those apps.

Lindy is a trial, not a free plan. New accounts get 50 dollars in credits that last 7 days, with no credit card. After that, the Team plan starts at 49.99 dollars a month for 5,000 credits, and each active user in the workspace is billed, according to Lindy's pricing page on November 7, 2026.


Is n8n free for AI agents?


Yes, if you self-host. The n8n Community Edition is free to run on your own server for as long as you like, under n8n's Sustainable Use License. n8n Cloud has a trial, not a free plan. The cheapest cloud plan, Starter, is 20 euros a month billed annually for 2,500 workflow executions. You also pay for the AI model you connect.


Is Zapier Agents free?


Yes. Zapier's Free plan includes 400 agent activities a month, with up to 10 activities in one agent run, and activities do not use your task allowance. Agents Pro raises that to 1,500 activities a month and 40 per run, from about 33.33 dollars a month billed annually, according to Zapier's pricing page on November 7, 2026.


What is the difference between a free plan and a free trial for AI agent builders?


A free plan resets every month and has no end date. A trial ends on a date or when its credits run out. In this guide, Taskade, Zapier, Botpress, MindStudio, Make, Stack AI, Retool, Activepieces, Dify and CrewAI sell a 0 dollar plan. Lindy, Gumloop, Chatbase and n8n Cloud offer a trial, and Relevance AI and Pickaxe show no free offer on their pricing pages.


Can I build an AI agent for free without coding?


Yes. Taskade, Zapier Agents, MindStudio, Botpress, Stack AI and Make build an agent from plain-language instructions or a visual editor on a 0 dollar plan. On Taskade, open the AI Agents tab and start from a ready-made agent template or a blank agent, then edit its instructions and knowledge. n8n, Dify and Langflow use a visual canvas that you self-host or run in the cloud, and CrewAI is a Python framework.


Which free AI agent builder works with my own API key?


Self-hosted n8n, Dify, Langflow and the CrewAI framework run on your own model key. MindStudio lists bring your own API keys on its Free plan. Taskade accepts your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google key in custom agents from Pro and up, and Claude runs in Taskade only on your own key.


When should I upgrade from a free AI agent builder?


Upgrade when the meter, not the feature list, stops your month: the agent runs out of runs, credits or conversations before the month ends, you need a second agent, you need a premium connector or a webhook, or a team needs to share the work. On Taskade, Pro at 10 dollars a month billed annually lifts all four.
